class.name: ECSCommandBuffer
class.description: [ECSCommandBuffer] allows systems running on background threads to request entity destruction or component changes safely without invalidating active iterators.

method.name: queue_destroy_entity
method.description: Queues an entity for destruction at the end of the current frame.

method.name: execute_deferred_commands
method.description: Executes all queued commands. Usually called automatically by the [ECSScheduler].
